headline: Deputy Governor Mejía anticipates an upward adjustment in Mexico's GDP forecast
summary: Banxico deputy governor Omar Mejía Castelazo said recent growth, including a stronger-than-expected latest reading, will likely lead the central bank to revise its GDP forecast upward.
why: Banxico is Mexico's central bank, and its growth forecasts guide its interest-rate decisions and investor expectations for the economy.
original_headline: Subgobernador Mejía anticipa un ajuste al alza en pronóstico del PIB de México
